name: Taihei Dengyo Kaisha, Ltd.
summary: Taihei Dengyo Kaisha, Ltd. engages in the plant construction business in Japan and internationally. The company constructs and maintains clean energy, steelmaking, petrochemicals, cement, waste disposal, recycling facilities, and theme parks, as well as thermal, nuclear, and geothermal power stations; and renewable energy power generation, such as biomass, geothermal and solar, and fuel cell power plants.
